name: email_draft
description: Write an email for the user: shows the draft in Notepad and asks whether to send it. Compose the subject and the message yourself from what the user said ('email Dad that I'll be late' is enough: write a short natural note in their voice). Only ask the user when the recipient or the point of the message is truly unknown.

to.description: a person's name as the user said it (Dad, Rohan) or an email address

body.description: the full message text, written in the user's voice, ready to send

send_draft.description: internal follow-up only, never set it

examples: email Dad that I'll be late for dinner
write an email to Rohan about Sunday lunch
send a mail to my professor asking for an extension
draft an email to hr@example.com about my leave
mail Mom that I reached home
